evidence.description: PCB trace analysis and CM504B pinout verification

provenance: PCB reverse engineering from weekend work 2025-12-01
raw_note:
Complete HA Address Line Mapping:

IC3 (CM504B) - HA00-HA05:
  HA00: GPC0 (SoC pin 49) → IC3.AIN→AOUT → HP45.HA00
  HA01: GPC1 (SoC pin 48) → IC3.BIN→BOUT → HP45.HA01
  HA02: GPC2 (SoC pin 47) → IC3.CIN→COUT → HP45.HA02
  HA03: GPC3 (SoC pin 46) → IC3.DIN→DOUT → HP45.HA03
  HA04: GPC4 (SoC pin 45) → IC3.EIN→EOUT → HP45.HA04
  HA05: GPC5 (SoC pin 44) → IC3.FIN→FOUT → HP45.HA05

IC4 (CM504B) - HA06-HA11:
  HA06: GPC6  (SoC pin 43) → IC4.AIN→AOUT → HP45.HA06
  HA07: GPC7  (SoC pin 42) → IC4.BIN→BOUT → HP45.HA07
  HA08: GPC8  (SoC pin 41) → IC4.CIN→COUT → HP45.HA08
  HA09: GPC9  (SoC pin 40) → IC4.DIN→DOUT → HP45.HA09
  HA10: GPC10 (SoC pin 39) → IC4.EIN→EOUT → HP45.HA10
  HA11: GPC11 (SoC pin 38) → IC4.FIN→FOUT → HP45.HA11

IC5 (CM504B) - HA12-HA17:
  HA12: GPC12 (SoC pin 37) → IC5.AIN→AOUT → HP45.HA12
  HA13: GPC13 (SoC pin 36) → IC5.BIN→BOUT → HP45.HA13
  HA14: GPC14 (SoC pin 35) → IC5.CIN→COUT → HP45.HA14
  HA15: GPC15 (SoC pin 34) → IC5.DIN→DOUT → HP45.HA15
  HA16: GPE0  (SoC pin 33) → IC5.EIN→EOUT → HP45.HA16
  HA17: GPE1  (SoC pin 32) → IC5.FIN→FOUT → HP45.HA17

IC6 (CM504B) - HA18-HA21 (shared with HP12-HP13):
  HA18: GPB15 (SoC pin 54) → IC6.AIN→AOUT → HP45.HA18
  HA19: GPD9  (SoC pin 52) → IC6.BIN→BOUT → HP45.HA19
  HA20: GPD10 (SoC pin 51) → IC6.CIN→COUT → HP45.HA20
  HA21: GPD11 (SoC pin 50) → IC6.DIN→DOUT → HP45.HA21

Key Points:
- CM504B level shifters: VCC = MCU logic level, VDD = head voltage (~12V)
- HA lines only drive FET gates (low current), no external MOSFETs needed
- Only ONE HA line should be active at a time during printing
- Firmware should configure GPC0-15, GPE0-1, GPB15, GPD9-11 as outputs
summary: The 22 HP45 address lines (HA0-HA21) are driven by four CM504B level shifters (IC3-IC6) from Nuvoton SoC GPIO pins. IC3-IC5 use primarily GPC0-GPC15 and GPE0-GPE1 for HA0-HA17. IC6 uses GPB15, GPD9-GPD11 for HA18-HA21. All HA lines are level-shifted from MCU VCC (~3.3V) to VDD (~12V) and drive FET gates inside the HP45 cartridge.
title: HP45 Address Lines (HA0-HA21) - Pin Mapping to Nuvoton SoC
